item.title: 5.2.8-beta.2
item.description:
ExtraDock 5.2.8 Beta 2 - Smoother Minimize on Every Screen! 🪟🖥️

🛠️ Fixed In Beta 2

  • One minimize animation, not two: Minimize no longer plays the macOS animation and the window effect one after the other (seen with two displays). The effect now plays only when the instant system minimize is really in place!

🆕 New In 5.2.8

  • Minimize windows into ExtraDock (Beta): With Deep-hide native macOS Dock on, turn on Settings › Behavior › Window Effects › Minimize windows into ExtraDock, and a window you minimize flies straight into its app's icon on your dock instead of the hidden macOS Dock. Click the icon and it flies back out!
  • Minimize effects (Beta): Pick how a window leaves the screen: Fly to Dock, Fade, Shatter, Explode or Black Hole!
  • More reliable in newly opened apps: Minimizing a window in an app you just opened now flies into your dock every time!
  • Smoother restores: Restoring several minimized windows flies them all back, and a window that comes back early never shows under the flying picture!
  • Safe on future macOS: If a macOS update stops supporting the instant minimize, ExtraDock leaves the macOS animation alone and tells you why in Settings!
  • Close effects (Beta): Choose an effect under Window Effects › When a window closes, and windows you close fade, shatter, explode or fall into a black hole. Works with or without Deep-hide!
  • Clear about Screen Recording: Window effects show a picture of the window, which needs Screen Recording. ExtraDock tells you before you turn an effect on, so the macOS permission prompt never comes as a surprise. You can also use the effects without window pictures!
  • Your Dock comes back when ExtraDock quits: Quitting ExtraDock now puts the macOS Dock and its minimize animation back, and opening ExtraDock hides them again!
  • Docks on every desktop: Docks set to show on all desktops now appear reliably on every desktop, including new ones!
  • Click to another desktop: Clicking an app whose window is on another desktop takes you there!
  • Change Window Icon…: With Show Windows Separately on, right-click a window item to give that one window its own icon!

📦 Also includes everything in 5.2.7

ExtraDock 5.2.7 - Every Window On Your Dock, Search In Settings & Dark Glass! 🪟🔍

✨ What's New

  • Show Windows Separately: Right-click an app on your dock (or open Manager › Items) and turn on "Show Windows Separately". Each open window of that app gets its own dock item right after it (up to 10, including windows on other Spaces). Click one to bring that exact window to the front, minimized windows show dimmed, and right-click a window item to close it. Works in Native Dock Copy and Running Apps sections too!
  • Search in Settings: A search field now sits at the top of the Settings sidebar. Type what you're looking for in your own words ("hide dock", "make the icons bigger") and Settings jumps to the right page, scrolls to the setting and highlights it!
  • Liquid Glass tone: Pick Clear, Light, Dark or Automatic under Style › Liquid Glass. Dark is new, and Automatic follows macOS Light and Dark mode live. "Dark glass" is now called Clear and looks the same, and new docks start on Automatic!
  • Docks go back when a Focus ends: Turn on Restore Docks When Focus Ends in Settings › Behavior › Focus Filters, and when a Focus turns off, the docks its ExtraDock filter showed or hid go back the way they were. A dock you changed by hand stays the way you left it!
  • Drag a file onto a running app: Rest a dragged file on a running app's dock icon and the app comes forward with its windows, so you can drop the file right where you want it!
  • Clock date color: The date on the Clock widget now follows your Text color, so it stays easy to read on a dark wallpaper. Want a different color? Pick one with the new Date color setting!
  • Bluetooth charging: The Bluetooth Battery widget shows a green bolt while a Magic Keyboard, Mouse or Trackpad is charging!

🚀 Improvements

  • Settings opens pages instantly: Every page shows at once, and changing a setting no longer makes your docks and widgets redraw. Closing Settings gives the memory back!
  • Smoother docks: Adding or removing apps, window items and running apps is lighter, and the dock never shifts while it animates!
  • Quicker launch: The Launch at Login and DockFlow connection checks no longer hold up ExtraDock at launch or while you work!
  • TamaDocky goes easy on your Mac: An idle pet uses far less CPU, and it pauses while it's covered, the screen is locked or the display sleeps!
  • Widgets stay put while you change a dock: Resizing or renaming a dock no longer restarts widgets such as the File Shelf and the System Trash!
  • Dock tabs make room for previews: With dock tabs set to "On hover", the tab strip steps aside while a window preview is open!
  • One icon per copy: Apps that run more than one copy at a time (like Wormhole) now show a dock icon for each copy, with its window title!
  • Trash empties right away: After you empty items you deleted from iCloud Drive, the Trash on your dock shows empty within seconds, even without Full Disk Access!
  • GIF widget follows your file: The GIF widget picks up your edits to the file you chose. If you added a GIF widget in 5.2.6, choose its GIF once more so it can follow the file!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • TamaDocky stays awake: A pet on a dock that collapses and expands no longer turns gray and stops responding!
  • Windows open on your desktop: With several desktops, Settings, the Manager, the activation window and widget windows such as File Shelf and Trash open on the desktop you're on!
  • Shift-click stays on your desktop: Shift-clicking an app to bring it to this screen never switches you to another desktop. If its window is on a desktop you're not looking at, ExtraDock beeps and leaves you where you are!
  • Reserve Dock Space and dragged windows: With Active on Drag off, a window you're holding is no longer moved mid-drag. It's moved out of the dock area after you let go!
  • System Trash widget: It keeps its icon while you resize the dock, "Allow Finder Access…" only appears while access is missing, and Widget Settings… and Remove Widget are back in its menu!
  • Settings window buttons: The window buttons no longer crowd the top-left corner on macOS Tahoe!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
